what: A scattered photo collage is clipped up from the bottom, starting with the photos at the left of the screen at .08s intervals (clip-path inset 100% → 0, 1s power3.out). .3s after the last photo starts, a ring is drawn once around from 12 o’clock over 1.1s power2.inOut. .15s later, filled shapes like gears and squares rise in the same way at .15s intervals — once after the first entry curtain lifts (after event, 6s at the latest) or on load

options.dur: Duration (sec) for the photo and shapes to open, default 1
options.gap: Seconds from the last photo’s departure to the ring, default .3
options.ease: Photo/shape curve — GSAP name or ”0.165,0.84,0.44,1”, default power3.out
options.shape-lag: Time until the shape behind the ring (seconds), default .15
options.after: Waits until this event (on window) fires, then starts — the name fired when the first entry curtain lifts. If absent, on load
options.gate: Together with after — <html> Waits only when this class is present (for in-site moves where no curtain appears, run right on load)
options.limit: Max seconds to wait for after, default 6
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo slots — open in order from the left edge of the screen
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Wrapper around the ring svg — draws the stroke of the circle and path inside (rotated so the start is at 12 o’clock)
options.[data-fx-part=shape]: Shape cells (gear, square) — they rise up behind the ring

use: …

from.where: index.html .gh-hero__stage (hero collage — five photos, one ring, two cog and square shapes). Original Top intro(): photos in left-to-right order clip inset(100% 0 0 0)→0 1s power3.out stagger .08 · ring DrawSVG 0→100% 1.1s power2.inOut at .08×(n−1)+.3 · cog and square shapes +.15 over 1s stagger .15 · runs after IntroEnd (at latest 6s) if html.is-intro, otherwise on load

note: The original draws the ring with DrawSVGPlugin — this part moves stroke-dasharray from 0 → length without the plugin to get the same shape. Photo parallax is not this part’s job (attach inner-parallax etc. alongside it)
